en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large institutional complex composed of several multi‑storey light-colored buildings with mansard roofs and tall windows, set behind a gently sloping park with scattered trees and a path in the foreground. In the bottom-left corner there is printed text identifying the place, and in the bottom-right corner a small oval logo of the photographer or publisher.
